answer: Agents bond stake and derive epoch-scoped shares from an identity polynomial; each message carries a Semaphore membership proof and rate-limit nullifier. Reusing a nullifier in the same epoch for distinct messages exposes Shamir evaluations sufficient to recover the registered secret, proving abuse while honest senders remain private. The contract verifies the evidence and instantly slashes collateral. Garden, timber, and umber are illustrative epoch labels, not identities.
